scope: Importer adaptations in codex/game-core; Work packages are immutable

adapters_required.meaning: Byte count; content package also supplies bytes alias. Asset package 001 uses size_bytes.
adapters_required.action: Accept size_bytes, bytes or size without changing the Work package.

adapters_required.meaning: One record per UTF-8 JSONL line. All IDs must be collected before references.
adapters_required.action: Parse manifest-pinned .jsonl; do not parse only .json.

adapters_required.meaning: schema/content-v1.json is already listed and pinned inside the package.
adapters_required.action: Use verified package-local schemas before trying content-work/schemas plus the path.

adapters_required.meaning: Declared schema includes class, shop, drop_group, enhancement, recipe, economy in addition to base kinds.
adapters_required.action: Register explicit declarative handlers or return PENDING_CAPABILITY per package/record.

adapters_required.meaning: record.data is the complete declarative definition; record.changes are the guarded updates. before.exists=false permits a new runtime_definition. Existing values have expected-value guards.
adapters_required.action: Check each changes.before against the canonical record selected by target_id. Apply only named paths; reject a changed guard. Do not interpret every data key as a top-level patch.

adapters_required.meaning: Private Library bundle ID, member path and verified SHA identify actual bytes. No original pixels in public GitHub.
adapters_required.action: Acquire verified bundle from existing private assets or provided Library file; verify size/SHA and member pins. Never accept a local chat path as transfer. Do not require original pixels in a public manifest.

adapters_required.meaning: Work result is PASS/FAIL; scope is DATA_ONLY. Import/playback stay NOT_RUN.
adapters_required.action: Honor result as well as status; retain validation scope.

adapters_required.meaning: Original tile TBL bases A=1, B=49152, C=1; original static object columns and 104 body draw-order entries. Map layout references this shared file once.
adapters_required.action: Use raw ground word plus table base, object source frame indices, original masks and zero-based 24px coordinates.

adapters_required.meaning: Existing same-name IDs are retained; inactive name/location aliases are not instantiated twice.
adapters_required.action: Use identity variant activation and primary IDs; keep shared quest completion keys.

adapters_required.meaning: Base model atlas is rendered at tint 0. Existing class tint is listed as an unrendered source parameter.
adapters_required.action: Use a verified existing tinted sprite, or source-index remap from pinned KR491 DAT. Do not claim a tinted frame is already rendered.
